lede: The biggest item this week is Tuesday's San Miguel County Commissioners meeting, where four separate public hearings will take up proposed Land Use Code amendments that would create an entirely new Natural Resources article covering forestry, oil and gas, and geothermal operations — foundational rules for how this county manages its land for generations. Alongside that, Telluride's HARC takes up the large-scale Shandoka redevelopment at 860 Black Bear Rd, the school board digs into the mill levy override discussion, and Norwood is updating both its Land Use Code and Master Plan — a busy week for decisions that stick.
